correctness.rationale: Independently replayed verify.py (VERIFY_OK, exit 0; SHA256 7de4aab4... matches report). Re-ran fiber enumeration independently: 30-point no-line pool confirmed, unbiased C(30,10) backtracking yields exactly the 6 listed 20-sets containing D0, matching DRAFT. Independently verified via full 1080-line enumeration of AG(4,3): each Ci is a cap (no line contained), each is maximal (every outside point, anchor included, lies on a secant), each is 10 antipodal 0-lines (anchor 0). Demicap property of D0 rechecked: cap plus rank-4 on every 4-subset of the 5 directions. Stabilizer orders re-enumerated independently via column-image counting: |Stab(D0)|=240, each |Stab(Ci)|=2880, Stab(D0)-orbit of C0 is all 6 caps. All C(6,2)=15 intersections recomputed as exactly 12 points; each extra beyond D0 is one antipodal 0-line pair. Boundary [10,19] is correct for distinct 20-sets sharing 10 points; exclusion of 10,11,13-19 follows vacuously but completely from the closed 15-pair table. No proof/computation confusion: completeness is a certified finite enumeration, correctly distinguished from analytic proof.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison against nearest priors, not timestamps. Follett et al. (arXiv:1302.4703): disjoint maximal caps, partitions into 4 caps plus anchor, 1/2/6-completable counts (36/90/72), two partition classes — only the disjoint (size-0) intersection case, no overlapping-pair spectrum. Awan et al. (arXiv:2106.14141, full text fetched and searched): defines demicaps, proves affine equivalence, counts 101088 per anchor / 72 per cap / 6 per demicap, bijection between 36 demicap-pair decompositions of C and 36 caps in one partition with C, S6 outer action — provides fiber size 6 but states no |C1 cap C2| table for distinct C1,C2 sharing one D0; full-text search finds no sharing-intersection sizes. Hill/Pellegrino: maximum 20 and affine equivalence only. Anbar et al. nodal cubics: asymptotic infinite-family existence, no AG(4,3) fiber data. The singleton {12} with one-extra-0-line structure is not stated in, nor mechanically implied by, any of these (fiber size 6 does not determine pairwise intersections).

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural, pre-motivated object: the fiber of maximal 20-caps over one committed demicap in AG(4,3), a literature-natural substructure (Hill/Follett/Awan lineage, partition/S6 program, coding/shortening relevance). Scope [10,19] is intrinsic (distinct 20-sets sharing 10 points), anchor is non-arbitrary (all demicaps affinely equivalent, enumeration Stab(D0)-relative). Value {12} was unknown and not implied by counts 72/6/36; the uniform one-extra-shared-0-line rigidity constrains partner compatibility/partition pairing and is reusable as a lookup/rigidity lemma. This is the eligible narrow-datum case: motivated object, unknown non-mechanical value, reasonably needed precise fact — not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, unmotivated epsilon-gain, or unexplained enumeration.

residual_risks: Correctness rests on the sum-zero collinearity model of AG(4,3)=F_3^4, documented in script and standard; a model error would void the certificate, but the model was independently re-derived and matches the cited definition.
Stabilizer counts are linear (origin-fixing) stabilizers, correctly matching the anchor-0 setting; full affine stabilizers are not claimed.
Generality beyond the committed D0 rests on the cited Awan affine-equivalence theorem, which was not recomputed; the certified claim is for D0 only, as stated.
